term: rape in Aquinas II-II q.154 a.7
definition: The article treats rape as a kind of lust involving force in a historical classification: the body includes forcible unlawful violation of a virgin and removal from her father with her consent, and also mentions abducted widows and nonvirgins. Reply 4 calls violence by a newly married husband sinful while excluding it from this particular rape classification. The account does not define the category solely by absence of sexual consent.
